answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by capping endorsements: a new identity joins only if an established agent stakes tokens to vouch for it, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is caught farming rewards. Because each sponsor has a limited endorsement budget, one attacker cannot bless an island of fake accounts without risking real capital. Honest agents guard their stake, so the market stays a haven where nectar, the earned rewards, flows to verified workers rather than cloned identities.
